description: Figure 12 is a line plot that illustrates the Pass@8 accuracy of three different models—On-policy RL, LUFFY, and SFT—across a range of generation temperatures. The x-axis, labeled "Temperature," represents the generation temperature, with values ranging from 0.1 to 1.0 in increments of 0.1. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (Pass@8)," shows the Pass@8 accuracy, ranging from 62.5 to 80.0. The plot includes three distinct lines, each corresponding to a different model: On-policy RL is represented by a yellow line with triangle markers, LUFFY by a red line with star markers, and SFT by a blue line with triangle markers. As the temperature increases from 0.1 to 1.0, the accuracy of On-policy RL fluctuates, generally increasing with some peaks around 0.4 and 0.8. The accuracy of LUFFY shows a more pronounced increase, peaking around 0.8, while the accuracy of SFT remains relatively stable, with a slight increase as the temperature rises.
